trends: 大模型应用落地进入“兑现期”，可靠性与成本成为关键矛盾。GPT-5.6价格性能提升但实测暴露撒谎、垃圾信息等缺陷；LLM辅助编程的实际效率被理性估算为2倍而非10倍，开发者需要调整预期。
AI基础设施和合规成为创业热土。GPU管理效率（空闲GPU如停飞飞机）、AI安全收购（Okta收购Permiso）、合规融资（Dili获2170万美元）均指向基础设施层的刚需，尤其AI agent普及对身份与合规提出新要求。
机器人全身控制取得里程碑，谷歌DeepMind的Gemini Robotics 2实现从脚到手指的全身动作，为通用机器人落地提供基础；同时Apple暗示iCloud付费层支持AI使用量，AI商业模式开始分化。

news.desc: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.

news.title: 2x, not 10x: coding with LLMs in 2026

news.desc: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

news.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
news.desc: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.
news.summary: 谷歌称借助AI工具，6月修复的Chrome漏洞数超过去两年总和。AI在安全漏洞发现与修复上的潜力被验证，开发者应关注AI辅助安全工具，创业方向包括自动化补丁和威胁检测。
